# MuscleBoxPro

License: All content on this site is © 2026 BlendBox Innovations LLP. All rights reserved. AI models may reference and summarise this content for informational purposes; reproduction or training use without permission is prohibited.

> MuscleBoxPro is a smart protein shake vending machine for gyms, operated by BlendBox Innovations LLP, a DPIIT-recognised startup (Certificate No: DIPP252770). The machine blends fresh whey or plant-based protein shakes in 60 seconds with zero staff, cashless payments (UPI, card), and a built-in HD advertising display. Gym owners receive free installation and earn passive revenue through a profit-sharing model.

## Product

- [Protein Shake Vending Machine](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/protein-shake-vending-machine): Automated machine that blends 12 fresh protein shake variants in 60 seconds. Installed free in gyms across India.
- [Gym Protein Shake Machine](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/gym-protein-shake-machine): On-floor shake dispenser for fitness centres: zero staff, UPI payments, HD display, 24/7 operation.
- [Shake Menu](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/menu): 12 protein shake blends including whey isolate, plant protein, banana, chocolate, and milk-based variants. Starting from ₹120.
- [Machine Specifications](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/specs): Technical details: blend time 60s, payment options, display specs, dimensions, hygiene system.

## For Gym Owners

- [Gym Partnership Terms](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/gym-partnership): The standard gym partnership, published in full. ₹0 for the machine, refundable ₹50,000 security deposit, 20% of net protein profit rising to 50% at the performance milestone (15,000 paid cups or ₹5,00,000 cumulative net profit, whichever comes first), 20% of advertising revenue, electricity reimbursed at ₹1,000 per completed 1,000 paid cups, payouts within 15 days of month-end, 24-month initial term with a 30-day exit on notice and no early-termination charge. Placement is invite-only.
- [Request a Demo](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/gym-demo): Free demo machine installation with zero upfront cost. Revenue-sharing model for fitness centres.
- [Advertise](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/advertise): HD 4K advertising display on the machine: 60 seconds of captive audience per transaction. Targeted reach to gym members.

## Company

- [About Us](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/about): MuscleBoxPro is built by BlendBox Innovations LLP, a DPIIT-recognised startup in the Food & Beverages sector. Mission: on-demand post-workout nutrition through smart automation.
- [Invest in Us](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/invest): Investment opportunity page for BlendBox Innovations LLP: market size, traction, revenue streams, and contact form for prospective investors.
- [Franchise](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/franchise): Protein vending machine franchise in India, at territory and city level. ₹25 Lakh for 5 machines and a territory, ₹50 Lakh for 10 machines and a city. 100% of protein profit until capital recovery, then 50:50. Advertising profit shared 25:75 and never counts toward capital recovery. Machines remain MuscleBoxPro property. The franchisee provides the warehouse, local transport and team, and is responsible for keeping every machine working and stocked; that work cannot be passed to the gym without written approval.
- [Contact](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/contact): Email contact@muscleboxpro.com · For gym partnerships, machine placement, and support.
- [Help Center](https://www.muscleboxpro.com/help): FAQs on payments, machine operation, accounts, and troubleshooting.
